challenges.title: OVERLOAD ORB
challenges.reward: TRIPLE outgoing spell damage for 45 seconds.
challenges.risk: A vulnerable neon orb circles you. Enemy contact ruptures it: lose 50% of MAXIMUM health and the damage bonus. This CAN KILL you at half health or below. Orb arms after 1 second.

challenges.title: UNSTABLE ECHO
challenges.reward: Every third spell hit creates a blast dealing TWICE that hit's damage within 180 cm. Active for 40 seconds.
challenges.risk: The marked blast detonates after 1 second. Standing inside costs 20% of MAXIMUM health, even during ordinary hit immunity. Keep moving! At most one echo every 0.5 seconds.

challenges.title: HOSTILE BROADCAST
challenges.reward: DOUBLE essence dropped by enemies defeated during this 60-second contract.
challenges.risk: Your location is broadcast. TWO ELITE HUNTERS arrive at 15, 30 and 45 seconds. Watch the reinforcement countdown. Hunters remain until defeated; normal enemy limits still apply.

challenges.title: DEADMAN BATTERY
challenges.reward: DOUBLE outgoing spell damage for 30 seconds. Every confirmed enemy kill restores 4% of maximum health.
challenges.risk: The battery drains 2% of MAXIMUM health per second, even during hit immunity. The drain CAN KILL you. Keep defeating enemies to stay charged.

challenges.title: GLASS PROTOCOL
challenges.reward: 75% more outgoing damage and TWO extra penetrations for attacks that support piercing. Active for 45 seconds.
challenges.risk: ALL incoming damage is DOUBLED for the same 45 seconds. A fractured holographic shell marks your vulnerability. Previously fired shots keep their launch-time penetration count.

challenges.title: JACKPOT COURIER
challenges.reward: Collect the marked volatile data cache and return to THIS sign within 35 seconds to earn ONE bonus three-card upgrade selection.
challenges.risk: While carrying the cache, pursuing enemies move 25% FASTER. Missing the delivery deadline causes 35% MAXIMUM-HP backlash. Follow the objective marker back to this sign.

challenges.title: LOCKDOWN DUEL
challenges.reward: Defeat the marked elite INSIDE the 9-meter-radius ring within 40 seconds. Earn ONE bonus three-card draft and 24 essence.
challenges.risk: Stay inside the visible ring. More than 2 seconds outside, leaving its elevation, or running out of time fails the contract and costs 35% MAXIMUM health. Normal enemies can enter. No invisible walls.
